summary: Phase 3 Integration Testing - All 22 backend tests PASSED. All 3 integrations (COGS→Executive Dashboard, Planogram→Fill Rate, Open Orders→Replenishment) are working correctly. Frontend verified with all pages loading and data displaying properly.

TEST_06_mrp_realisation_fallback.notes: Fallback logic verified - uses mrp_realisation when no COGS

TEST_08_uploaded_planogram_source.notes: Demo tenant has planogram data, norm_source='uploaded_planogram'

FE_01_executive_dashboard.notes: Executive Dashboard loads with Revenue, Units, MRP Realisation, Health Score KPIs

FE_02_data_upload_page.notes: Data Upload page shows all 10 upload types including COGS, Planogram, Open Orders

FE_03_planogram_fill_rate.notes: Planogram Fill Rate page shows fill rate data, store/category breakdowns

FE_04_replenishment_planner.notes: Replenishment Planner shows Order Quantity tab with formula, PO value, priority breakdown

COGS_to_Executive_Dashboard.notes: COGS data (1700) is very small compared to revenue (361M), resulting in ~100% margin. This is expected behavior - the integration is working correctly.

Planogram_to_Fill_Rate.notes: Planogram data uploaded, norm_source correctly shows 'uploaded_planogram'. Fill rate >100% because current stock exceeds norm (overstocked).

Open_Orders_to_Replenishment.notes: Open orders data uploaded, in-transit quantity (180 units) correctly deducted from order requirements.

issues: Formula display shows 'Order Qty = (Cover Days x Avg Sales) - Current Stock' but doesn't mention in-transit deduction. Backend correctly implements the full formula including in-transit.
Shows 'MRP Realisation' KPI but not a dedicated 'Margin' KPI card. The margin_source and margin_pct are returned by API but may not be prominently displayed.

critical_code_review_comments: All 3 Phase 3 integrations are correctly implemented in backend
COGS integration: margin_source field correctly indicates data source, true margin calculated when COGS available
Planogram integration: norm_source field correctly indicates 'uploaded_planogram' vs 'auto_derived'
Open Orders integration: in_transit_qty correctly deducted from order requirements, open_orders_source field added
Minor UI enhancement opportunity: Update Order Quantity formula display to include '- In Transit' for clarity
context_for_next_testing_agent: Phase 3 Integration Testing complete. All 3 integrations verified: (1) COGS→Executive Dashboard returns margin_source, total_cogs, mrp_realisation_pct fields, (2) Planogram→Fill Rate returns norm_source field indicating 'uploaded_planogram' or 'auto_derived', (3) Open Orders→Replenishment returns total_in_transit and open_orders_source fields, detail rows include in_transit_qty. Demo tenant has test data for all 3 new collections. All regression tests for existing analytics endpoints passed.
